question: Should this PR land as the top of the publisher follow/feed stack, be split down to feed routes only, or wait until the follow API, controls, and notification dependency PRs land first?
rationale: The branch carries multiple open draft dependency slices plus a new public API and private persistent state, so automation cannot choose the product/API boundary or stack landing order.

options.title: Resolve the stack first
options.body: Land or update the dependency PRs, rebase this branch, then review it with real runtime and browser proof for the full follow/feed path.

options.title: Split feed routes only
options.body: If maintainers only want canonical public feed URLs now, split the follow graph and notification fanout back into narrower PRs before reviewing this branch.

options.title: Pause the feature stack
options.body: Leave this draft parked until maintainers confirm the broader publisher follow/feed API direction.

recommendation.title: Resolve the stack first
recommendation.body: Land or update the dependency PRs, rebase this branch, then review it with real runtime and browser proof for the full follow/feed path.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent history owns the route/API/schema package baseline that the product-boundary decision extends.
